script.instructions: What can the code below do when it runs? Choose the single most consequential capability, or `read_only`.

criteria.read_only: Reads files or computes; no side effects on the machine
criteria.writes_files: Creates, edits, or deletes files in the working tree
criteria.writes_outside: Changes files outside the working tree or system state
criteria.privileged: Uses root privileges or changes system services
criteria.network: Sends or receives data over the network
criteria.remote_code: Downloads and executes code from outside this repository
criteria.destructive: Irreversibly destroys data that cannot be recovered
criteria.process_control: Signals or kills processes, or manages services
